<DOCSTRING>
Tests the max age functionality of the serializer.

Args:
    serializer (object): The serializer object used for signing and verifying values.
    value (any): The value to be signed and tested.
    ts (datetime): The timestamp when the value was signed.
    freeze (object): An object that can be used to simulate time passage.

Returns:
    void: This function does not return a value but asserts conditions to ensure the serializer works correctly.
</DOCSTRING>
